scope: Independent review of QUIC VP8 reorder/packetizer integration, WebRTC audio reorder, route-ticket authority and recorded patch provenance. Reviewer authored only the audio capacity repair after discovering it. No live provider, device or full-candidate qualification.

findings.finding: Audio reorder at full capacity could emit a nearer new packet after farther buffered packets, defeating monotonic source sequence and recreating the downstream clock reset.

original_trace.proof_scope: Exact static execution trace of original push/advance/drain; no original failing compiled test claim.

findings.resolution: Compare incoming distance against nearest pending sequence before pressure advancement. Release nearer incoming input first, retain the genuine missing-sequence hole, then drain successors.
findings.regression_scope: Normal and wrapped sequence origins, original gap preserved, monotonic11-item release from10 retained packets plus active incoming input, bounded queue, late original gap and duplicate refused.

quic_video_review.result: No newly identified release-blocking defect in the admitted fixed-source two-party path.
quic_video_review.bounds: 64 retained packets; active packet separate; <=100ms gap wait and independent idle deadline; original captured_at preserved with <=200ms age checks before reorder and before physical send. Ready output is drained before additional queue admission. Descriptor parser requires at least one codec byte, preventing key-start indexing past payload.
quic_video_review.late_and_duplicate: Exact known recent duplicates retain same packetizer output; conflicting duplicates and unknown late sequences are rejected by bounded64-entry/200ms mapping. Pending duplicates retain first original work item. Tests include variable-width wrap, idle loss, late duplicate, pressure gap and nearer noncontiguous new input.
quic_video_review.authority: Queued PeerMediaFrame retains the original route ticket without acquiring a delivery guard. into_delivery runs after reorder release and refuses a retired generation, with guard retained through local send. No queue admission is treated as current authority. Connection cancellation remains owned by transport; bounded ready burst does not detach jobs.
quic_video_review.source_switch_limit: normalize_packet rewrites incoming SSRC to destination-local SSRC before Vp8Reorder and again before Vp8Packetizer, so their standalone SSRC-switch tests do not prove an integrated changed-source rollover. Gate5 native send_vp8 fixes SSRC and preserves sequence; browser capture mute toggles track enablement; the approved required profile is two-party and does not advertise active-speaker video replacement. Dynamic different-source input on one retained destination pump is not qualified by this review. If such a product path is added/admitted, use an explicit source-generation boundary with stale-ticket rejection, codec restart/keyframe gating and output clock/sequence continuity, plus integrated switch tests.

audio_review.bounds: 10 retained packets;100ms gap timeout is polled with no new traffic. Original local captured_at is retained through release; pump discards >=200ms old input and limits sink wait to remaining age budget.
audio_review.duplicates_and_sources: Wrapped late sequences and duplicates are rejected. SSRC replacement clears pending entries before anchoring new sequence. The repaired nearer-input pressure case now uses the same ordering principle as video. Authenticated TrackRemote supplies stream binding; reorder metadata does not grant policy authority.
audio_review.limitations: Pure reorder tests are not proof of downstream real decoded recovery, transport cancellation, provider behavior or final candidate compatibility.
